resolvable.question: What input container does the hftbacktest Rust crate accept - flat binary of the 8-field Event, or npy/npz?
resolvable.answer: npy/npz only: read_npy_file, read_npz_file, and the crate ships write_npy. Flat binary is not accepted. Event is repr(C, align(64)), eight fields on exactly 64 bytes, last field named fval not faval. Decision 17 records this; no extra npy dependency is needed.
